Committee: Judiciary
Sponsor: Whatley
Analyst: Pete Grogan
Date: 04/08/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 232 as passed the Senate could decrease the potential obligations of county and municipal jails, by an undetermined amount dependent on the number of individuals who could have been confined in jail for certain traffic violations and who would now not be confined based on the provisions of this bill.
Jim Hill, Chair
Judiciary

Senate Bill 232 as introduced could decrease the future obligations of county and municipal jails, by an undetermined amount dependent on the number of individuals who could have been confined in jail for certain traffic violations and who would now not be confined based on the provisions of this bill.
